name: .408 Cal-296gr Pittman Hammer
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting with smokeless muzzle loader. The product page also says: "The Pittman Hammer is a pure copper, full form, smokeless muzzle loader bullet designed in collaboration with Pittman Bullets for normal to long range big game hunting. This 296gr Pittman Hammer is designed with a small 1.5mm hollow point for high bc."
